explication: This repository is a hands-on MCP learning curriculum, not one integrated runtime application. Its principal workflow teaches a client to discover and invoke server tools, optionally using an LLM to choose a tool, then return the result. Separate lessons extend that pattern with transports, authentication, UI resources, sampling, and external services. The graph focuses on representative examples; unsampled lesson wiring is omitted rather than inferred.
